name: ceramics-api
description: The single backend service for the store: product catalog and search, cart, checkout orchestration (stock/price re-validation, shipping fee, tax, Stripe payment), order lifecycle, and the admin catalog/inventory/order-management operations. Owns ceramics-db exclusively. Exposed only to the two web-apps on the intranet boundary via the platform gateway; enforces the shopper/admin role split from X-User-Groups. Does not implement its own JWT validation or CORS handling (gateway-provided) and does not store card data.

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, variants/stock, carts, orders, accounts, and saved addresses.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates shopper/admin sign-in tokens; the gateway injects X-User-Id and X-User-Groups (admin role) per request.

dependencies.name: payment-provider
dependencies.description: Creates and confirms Stripe PaymentIntents during checkout; card data never touches this service directly.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create/confirm PaymentIntents.
Signing secret used to verify Stripe webhook payloads.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: SendGrid v3 REST API, used to send order confirmation and shipment-notification emails to shoppers via POST /v3/mail/send.

config.description: SendGrid API key used to authenticate mail-send requests.
The verified sender address order/shipment emails are sent from.
